patches.description: Changes the version code of the app. This will turn off app store updates and allows downgrading an existing app install to an older app version.

patches.name: Copy comment
patches.description: Adds buttons to copy comments and their authors' usernames on posts and reels.

patches.name: Custom font
patches.description: Adds an option to replace the app font with a font file from the device storage.

patches.description: Disables the endless scrolling behavior in Instagram Reels, preventing swiping to the next Reel. Note: On a clean install, the 'Tip' animation may appear but will stop on its own after a few seconds.

patches.description: Block analytics that are sent to Instagram/Facebook servers.

Reels shared with you still open. Unlocking early requires a 24 hour cooling-off period, and resetting or importing settings is blocked while locked.

patches.name: Hide nudge button
patches.description: Hides follow/subscribe/follow back buttons on posts

patches.name: Hide post metrics
patches.description: Hides like, reposts etc counts.

patches.name: Hide promote button
patches.description: Hides promote button under self posts

patches.name: Hide recommendation items
patches.description: Adds options to hide recommendation items such as "Who to follow" and "Today's news" in timeline, search, and replies.

patches.name: Import/Export login token
patches.description: Adds an feature to export and import the token of accounts. This is useful when logging in on your second device or when re-installing piko.

patches.name: Legacy share links
patches.description: Brings back username on post share links. Works post 11.4x.xx

patches.name: Log server response
patches.description: Log json responses received from server

patches.name: More information on profile
patches.description: Adds more details on the profile page

patches.name: Native downloader
patches.description: Requires X 11.0.0-release.0 or higher.

patches.name: Native reader mode
patches.description: Requires X 11.0.0-release.0 or higher.

patches.name: Native translator
patches.description: Requires X 11.0.0-release.0 or higher.

patches.name: No shortened URL
patches.description: Get rid of t.co short urls.

patches.name: Pause search suggestions
patches.description: Search suggestions will not be saved locally

patches.name: Remove Ads
patches.description: Removed promoted posts, trends and google ads

patches.name: Remove premium upsell
patches.description: Removes premium upsells

patches.name: Remove search suggestions
patches.description: Hide/Remove search suggestion in explore section

patches.name: Remove view count
patches.description: Removes the view count from the bottom of tweets

patches.name: Restore legacy follower lists
patches.description: Restores the legacy follower and following list screen.

patches.name: Round off numbers
patches.description: Enable or disable rounding off numbers

patches.name: Selectable Text
patches.description: Makes bio and username selectable

patches.name: Share Tweet as Image
patches.description: Share tweets as rendered image. Requires X 11.0.0-release.0 or higher.

patches.name: Show changelogs
patches.description: Shows changelogs when new a patch is installed.

patches.name: Show poll results
patches.description: Adds an option to show poll results without voting

patches.name: Show post source label
patches.description: Source label will be shown only on public posts
